Title: Microsoft Authentication Libraries for .Net, IOS, Android, and JavaScript

Body.Content:
Microsoft Authentication Libraries for JavaScript, iOS, and Android will soon be in preview. Additionally, the available Microsoft Authentication Library Preview for .Net will be updated. Microsoft Authentication Library will enable developers to build web, mobile, and PC applications that sign in both Microsoft personal accounts, and Azure Active Directory work and school accounts. It'll also enable developers to get access tokens to call the Microsoft Graph. Microsoft Authentication Library will use Azure Active Directory V2 endpoint, which combines access to personal, work, and school accounts. It's the successor to the Active Directory Authentication Library, which will remain fully supported throughout the Microsoft Authentication Library Preview. 

For more information visit the product website or read the Azure AD V2 developer guide.
